name: Tinned tomatoes
description: Tomatoes peeled and packed in their own juice — the base of most Western sauces.

tcm.note: Read with tomato, which is cool and fluid-generating.

ayurveda.note: Sour and ushna, like the fresh fruit.

histamine.note: Fresh tomato is already among the highest fresh foods; concentrating and tinning it lifts it further.

guna.note: Aged, cured or fermented — the condition the texts call tamasic, whatever the ingredient started as.
